entries.title: Shilika Jain: credentials, roles and client roster
entries.body:
Use for first-person authority lines and E-E-A-T. Only these facts are on record.

Roles:
- Currently leading APAC PR + Partnerships at Myosin, a growth-marketing DAO in the US.
- Previously APAC Lead at CoinMarketCap, leading Partnerships & PR there for 1.5 years.
- Marketing at Web3 agencies Momentum6 and Bloom360.
- Freelance author at The Chainsaw (Australia's leading crypto publication) and contributor at CryptoDailyUK (https://cryptodaily.co.uk/author/ShilikaJain).

What I do:
- End-to-end PR from narrative to placements in Global and APAC media (Forbes, Cointelegraph, CoinDesk, Blockworks), plus localisation.
- Drafting press releases, op-eds and pitch materials; media relations, monitoring, reporting; brand positioning.
- Targeted journalist pitches for product, funding, partnership and ecosystem news.
- Founder profiling through podcasts, expert commentary and op-eds.
- Strategic PR campaigns and crisis communications.
- GTM strategy for early-stage Web3 projects; on-ground media support at events.
- Influencer marketing with a network of 200+ Web3 influencers (150+ with strong direct relationships), plus developer and regional communities.
- Off-page SEO through link building.

Clients worked with: Fluence, GAIA, WalletConnect, ParaSwap, Rootstock, RARI Foundation, MANTRA Chain, LightLink, Ripple, Solana Saga, Elastos (BTC L2), OKX, MEXC, Animoca Brands, NEAR Foundation, Polygon, Bluzelle, Stader Labs, Chainbase, Web3Auth, Starknet, Arcana Network, Reef Finance, Frontier Wallet, Hefty Art, Bullieverse, Nakamoto Games, DFO, UpOnly, Tangem, Magna, Aurora Labs.

Notable X threads: The FTX saga, Genesis & Gemini (https://twitter.com/Shilika_jain/status/1592950565059055617); Battle of L1s & L2s (https://twitter.com/Shilika_jain/status/1566813265799176193).

entries.title: Case study: Tangem Wallet self-custody report coverage
entries.body:
Tangem's self-custody survey (headline stat: 66% / two-thirds of crypto users support self-custody; cold-wallet adoption around 15%) was turned into a data story and picked up across global and Asian outlets in 2026.

Coverage: Metaverse Post (https://mpost.io/tangem-two-thirds-of-crypto-users-support-self-custody-as-hardware-wallets-evolve-beyond-asset-protection/), CryptoFocus NL, Watcher.Guru (https://watcher.guru/news/two-thirds-of-cryptocurrency-traders-back-self-custody-wallets), Binance Square news, KuCoin News flash, CoinHeadlines, CoinPasar (Singapore), Bloomingbit in English, Korean and Japanese editions (https://bloomingbit.io/feed/news/115416), FXDailyReport, TechBullion.

Lesson to draw: an owned data report gives journalists a stat to lead with, and one stat travelled across EN, KR, JP and NL editions without a separate pitch per market.

entries.title: Case study: GAIA (decentralized AI) founder profiling and coverage
entries.body:
Founder-led visibility for GAIA's CEO Matt Wright and co-founder/COO Shashank Sripada, Dec 2024 to Apr 2025.

Tier-1 and trade: Forbes, "AI Agents 101: The Future Of Agentic Web And Onchain AI" (Dec 2024, https://www.forbes.com/sites/clorischen/2024/12/23/ai-agents-101-the-future-of-agentic-web-and-onchain-ai/); Decrypt, "Gaia is Building 'Living Knowledge Systems' for AI" (Jan 29 2025, https://decrypt.co/297060/gaia-is-building-living-knowledge-systems-for-ai-agents); Benzinga, "Centralized Models, Data Access As Key Roadblocks To Decentralized AI Shift" (Feb 24 2025); CryptoDaily UK interview with Shashank Sripada on building "the Stripe for AI agents" (Consensus Hong Kong edition, Mar 2025); Binance Square, "Gaia Hits 400K Nodes & Expands Decentralized Intelligence with 3 Strategic Partnerships" (Apr 19 2025).

Podcasts and video: Rug Radio (Dec 2024), Francesco Andreoli (Dec 2024), Web3 with Sam Kamani (Mar 2025), Agents Unleashed Denver '25 spotlight, Crypto Coin Show (400,000+ nodes episode, Apr 2025), Blockster interview with Matt Wright (Apr 2025), The Boss Code (Apr 2025), plus an exclusive COO interview (Apr 2025).

Lesson: a steady cadence of founder interviews around one narrative (decentralized AI agents, node count as proof) compounds into tier-1 pickup.

entries.title: Case study: Fluence (DePIN compute) thought leadership and op-eds
entries.body:
Positioned Fluence co-founder Tom Trowbridge as a DePIN voice through op-eds, newsjacking and interviews.

Coverage: CoinDesk op-ed "Not a meme: DePIN can take crypto mainstream" (Apr 2025, https://www.coindesk.com/opinion/2025/04/03/not-a-meme-depin-can-take-crypto-mainstream); Benzinga exclusive on network resilience (Jul 2024); Decrypt commentary (https://decrypt.co/239771/bitcoin-170-million-short-traders-liquidation) and "Why DePIN can solve tech's biggest issues" (https://decrypt.co/283666/why-depin-solve-tech-biggest-issues); e27 piece tying the global Microsoft outage to the need for DePIN compute (Sep 2024, newsjacking); Cointelegraph Hashing It Out on DePIN's role in the next cycle; CryptoDaily UK interview at Devconnect Bangkok on revenue as the key DePIN metric (Dec 2024); Metaverse Post, Blockster interview, crypto.news expert roundup on ZK proofs, Cryptowisser, Bitcoin Magazine NL.

Also: DePIN Day Hong Kong (Fluence x Titan Network) covered in Chinese media (Blocktempo) and DePIN Day Singapore in CryptoTimes JP.

Lesson: newsjacking a mainstream outage gave an infrastructure story a reason to run outside crypto media.

entries.title: Case study: RARI Foundation / Rari Chain mainnet launch
entries.body:
Launch PR for Rari Chain mainnet on Arbitrum (Jan 2024), framed around protecting NFT creator royalties.

Coverage: CoinDesk Protocol newsletter (Jan 18 2024), Cointelegraph on NFT creator royalty payments, The Block ("RARI Foundation launches Rari Chain mainnet on Arbitrum to help protect NFT royalties"), The Defiant, Cryptonews, Metaverse Post, NFTgators, CryptoDaily UK, CryptoPanic, CoinMarketCap community, ICOholder.

Lesson: a single sharp angle (royalties guaranteed at chain level) let one mainnet launch land in CoinDesk, The Block and Cointelegraph the same week.

entries.title: Case study: MANTRA Chain $11M raise (RWA)
entries.body:
Funding PR for MANTRA Chain's $11M raise for RWA tokenization (Mar 2024), with a Middle East angle.

Coverage: CoinDesk, "MANTRA Chain raises $11M for RWA tokenization with Middle East tint" (Mar 19 2024); CryptoDaily UK; CryptoPotato; Cointelegraph interview "Everything tokenized" with CEO John Mullin (amplified on Cointelegraph's X); Milk Road Daily feature (YouTube + Spotify).

Lesson: funding news ran wider because it carried a regional angle (Middle East) and a category word (RWA) reporters were already covering.

entries.title: Case study: Web3Auth (wallets / onboarding) PR
entries.body:
Ongoing PR for Web3Auth in 2023 to 2024.

Coverage: Google Cloud partnership (Firebase extension) covered by Benzinga, The Cryptonomist, Cryptonews FR and the CoinDesk Protocol newsletter (Oct 2023); Blockworks on MPC wallet security and the WaaS Firebase extension; Yahoo Finance on the Trust Wallet partnership; Cointelegraph on wallet convenience tech and expert commentary; a Web3Auth adoption report covered by Cryptonews ("Security concerns and high costs top obstacles in Web3 adoption"); CryptoDaily UK interview with Zhen Yu on MPC wallets; Edge of NFT podcast.

Lesson: pairing a big-name Web2 partner (Google Cloud) with a report gave two separate news hooks in one quarter.

entries.title: Case study: Magna (token management) expert commentary
entries.body:
Expert-commentary placements for Magna in 2023: Decrypt on Worldcoin tokenomics at launch (supply and market-maker loans), Cryptonews on Ethereum L2 activity near all-time highs, a Rollup podcast interview, and on-ground interviews set up with CoinDesk at Messari Mainnet.

Lesson: commentary on a trending launch (Worldcoin) got a B2B infra brand into Decrypt without its own news.

entries.title: Case study: Elastos (BTC L2) commentary and research placements
entries.body:
Elastos placements in 2023: Cointelegraph Hashing It Out episode "Cloud meets Web3"; Cryptonews on Ethereum L2 activity; CryptoPotato experts weighing in on Worldcoin and proof of personhood; Cryptonews on research showing 67% of Nigerians trust Bitcoin for life savings over traditional methods.

Lesson: commissioned regional research (Nigeria) earned a standalone headline.

entries.title: Case study: Aurora Labs / NEAR enterprise blockchain PR
entries.body: Aurora Labs (NEAR ecosystem): Breaking Chains podcast interview; CryptoPotato DeFi feature on opportunities, bottlenecks and compliance; Bitcoin.com News on Aurora's turnkey blockchain for businesses moving to Web3; Crypto Intelligence on enterprise blockchains and L2s; a Flipside Crypto Twitter Space with about 400 attendees.

entries.title: Case study: Bullieverse $4M raise (India metaverse gaming)
entries.body:
Fundraise PR for Bullieverse's $4M round (Feb 2022). Scope: narrative and messaging for the one-off funding release, writing and distributing the release to journalists, organic pitching plus some sponsored placements, and 2 to 3 journalist interviews.

Indian mainstream and startup media: Economic Times ("Metaverse platform Bullieverse bags $4 million funding led by Web3 venture funds"), Inc42, Entrackr, YourStory, VCCircle, Tech in Asia. Crypto and tech: Cointelegraph press release, NewsBTC, Hackernoon founder interview, Investing.com (Chainlink VRF integration). CoinDesk placement was sponsored content, not earned.

Lesson: an Indian-founded team's raise is a mainstream business story in India (ET, Inc42), not just a crypto story.

entries.title: Case study: Hefty Art x Sotheby's M.F. Husain NFT auction
entries.body:
Hefty Art partnered with Sotheby's for the first phygital auction of Indian modern artist M.F. Husain. Scope: narrative for the fundraising release, release distribution, organic pitching plus sponsored coverage, 2 to 3 interviews with podcasters and X influencers, and listings on CryptoSlam and NFT Calendar.

Coverage: The Chainsaw (traditional art NFTs), Cryptopolitan, NullTX, The Layer, plus E-DAO announcement pickups in Blockonomi, CoinQuora and ZyCrypto.

entries.title: Case study: APAC localisation, Korea / Japan / China / Vietnam coverage
entries.body:
Localised coverage secured across APAC for multiple clients.

Korea, mainstream and crypto (monthly visitors per SimilarWeb as recorded in the portfolio): Hankyung (37.7M, via Naver), E-Daily (11.3M), ZDNet Korea (4M), Digital Times (2M), Bloomingbit (5M, blockchain arm of a major Korean economic outlet), Tokenpost (2.6M), CoinReaders (5.5M), CoinNess (largest active-user Korean Web3 news app, strong in Korean Telegram channels), Blockmedia.

Japan: CryptoTimes JP (DePIN Day Singapore), Cointelegraph JP (Bomber Quest, a P2E game from Astar Network), BeInCrypto JP.

Multi-language for RiskLayer's builders-round funding (restaking / EigenLayer DeFi security middleware): Coinphony in Korean, Vietnamese and Russian; BeInCrypto Japanese and Italian; Chinese pickups in ChainCatcher, TechFlow, Jinse, PANews and Blocktempo (DePIN Day Hong Kong, Fluence x Titan Network).

Lesson: Korean reach comes from Naver-syndicated mainstream outlets plus Telegram-driven apps like CoinNess, not from translating an English release and hoping.
